scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -s first -n server,ui "AGENT_MANAGER_PORT=6051 bun --filter @agent-manager/server dev" "AGENT_MANAGER_UI_PORT=6050 AGENT_MANAGER_API_URL=http://agent-manager-api.localhost bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 6050 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron "AGENT_MANAGER_UI_PORT=6050 AGENT_MANAGER_API_URL=http://agent-manager-api.localhost bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 6050 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:6050 && AGENT_MANAGER_PORT=6051 bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop dev"
scripts.smoke:electron: concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron "AGENT_MANAGER_UI_PORT=6050 AGENT_MANAGER_API_URL=http://agent-manager-api.localhost bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 6050 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:6050 && AGENT_MANAGER_PORT=6051 AGENT_MANAGER_SMOKE=1 bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop dev"
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @agent-manager/ui check && bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop typecheck && bun --filter @agent-manager/server typecheck
